user.title: Add a meter
user.description: Choose which kind of meter to add. If you have two, add them one at a time.

details.title: Add a meter
details.description: Add a gas or water meter. Enter the current reading (whole cubic metres), or pick an existing sensor to import its value and take over its entity ID, so your Energy dashboard history continues without a gap.

data_description.initial_reading: Only the whole part, without decimals. Leave empty to import it from the existing sensor.
data_description.existing_entity: For example sensor.gas_consumption from the old package. Its value is imported and its entity ID is reused once the old sensor is gone.

error.reading_required: Enter the current reading, or pick an existing sensor that has a valid numeric value.

abort.already_configured: A meter with this type and name already exists.

data.ai_task_entity: AI Task entity for photo reading
data.existing_entity: Sensor whose name and history to take over

data_description.ai_task_entity: Used to read the meter from a photo. Leave empty to use the default AI Task entity.
data_description.max_jump: A new reading higher than the last one by more than this needs an explicit confirmation.
data_description.existing_entity: To keep the history of the old package: pick the old sensor here (e.g. sensor.gas_consumption). First remove the package and delete the old sensor from Entities; the new one then takes its name and the statistics continue.

set_reading.name: Set reading
set_reading.description: Records a new meter reading in whole cubic metres. It must not be lower than the current one, unless the meter was replaced.

reading.name: Reading
reading.description: Meter reading in m³, whole part only.

force.name: Confirm large increase
force.description: Accept an increase larger than the configured maximum.

replace_meter.name: Meter replaced
replace_meter.description: Accept a lower reading because the meter was replaced. Consumption already counted in the current periods is kept.

read_from_photo.name: Read from photo
read_from_photo.description: Reads the whole part of the meter reading from an image using an AI Task entity. It only returns a proposal and never saves it.

media.name: Image
media.description: Image of the meter (for example a camera or media source).

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Copies the long-term statistics of an old sensor (even a deleted one) onto this sensor, so charts and the Energy dashboard continue without a gap. Safe to run again.

source.name: Source sensor
source.description: ID of the old sensor, for example sensor.gas_consumption.

repair_statistics.name: Repair statistics
repair_statistics.description: Removes jumps in the history sums (for example negative bars in the Energy dashboard after an import). Re-reads the stored readings and recomputes the sums starting from the most recent hour. Safe to repeat.

reading_lower.message: The new reading {new} is lower than the current one ({current}). If the meter was replaced, use the replaced-meter option.

reading_jump.message: The new reading {new} is {max} m³ or more above the current one ({current}). Confirm it explicitly if it is correct.

photo_unavailable.message: The photo entity is not available yet.

ai_task_missing.message: The AI Task integration is not available. Add an AI provider (for example Google Gemini or Ollama) first.

no_history.message: No statistics found for {source}. Check the exact ID in Developer tools → Statistics.

nothing_to_import.message: Nothing to import: this sensor already has history that starts before or together with the source.

same_source.message: The source must be a different sensor than the target.

entity_id_busy.title: Entity ID {entity_id} is still in use
entity_id_busy.description: The meter "{name}" could not take over {entity_id} because another active entity uses it. Remove the old package or entity, then reload this integration.
